title: People wey you dey look after
lead: See quick-quick how your people dey today: their check-in, water, and any danger sign.

empty.title: Nobody yet
empty.body: Tell your papa, mama or relative make dem open Living Dose for their phone, go Account → Family helpers, and send you their invite link.
empty.own: You want make person look after you? Invite dem from Account → Family helpers.

urgentBody: Dem talk say: {{what}}. Abeg call dem now now. If dem no pick, or dem wan faint, call 112.
unwellBody: Quick call fit help. If their body never well for some days, tell dem make dem see doctor.
quietBody: Small reminder from you fit help dem continue.
loadError: We no fit load your family. Abeg check your network.

join.title: {{name}} want make you look after am
join.body: You go see {{name}} daily check-in, any danger sign, how much water e don drink, and the streak. You no go see wetin e answer for health check, wetin e chop, or the private notes.
join.done: You don dey look after {{name}} now.
join.notFound: This invite link no dey work. Abeg ask for new one.
join.used: Person don use this invite link before. Abeg ask for new one.
join.expired: This invite link don expire (link dey last 7 days). Abeg ask for new one.
join.own: Na your own invite link be this. Send am to the family person wey you want make e look after you.
join.setup: Family helpers never on yet. Abeg try again later.
join.demoSelf: Demo mode: you dey accept your own invite so you fit see how e be.

account.title: Family helpers
account.intro: Make your pikin or person wey dey care for you see how you dey every day, from their own phone. Dem go see your daily check-in, danger sign, water and streak. Dem no go see wetin you answer for health check, wetin you chop or your notes.
account.linkReady: Send this link to your family person. E go work one time and e go last 7 days.
account.whatsappText: Hello, I want make you look after my health for Living Dose. Press this link make you join: {{link}}
account.helpingTitle: People wey you dey look after
account.error: Something no work. Abeg try again.
